properties.name: 100-ft road no-hunt setback
properties.description: Approximate 100-ft (30.48 m) buffer around AGFC WMA Transportation roads (FeatureServer/8, Mount Magazine WMA). No hunting within 100 ft of a road (AGFC). Buffer uses ~0.00032 deg (~100-110 ft); not a surveyed setback. Fetched 2026-10-05.
properties.rule: No hunting within 100 ft of a road
